thread:
jules: HelioHealth RFP follow-up: they sent a detailed capability matrix and asked for clarifications on single-tenant options, network isolation, and support SLAs. Can we align answers by EOD tomorrow?
jules: Matrix attached in RFP email: https://files.heliohealth.com/rfp/capability-matrix.xlsx
nina: I reviewed. Main gaps: our documentation needs a clearer statement on Dedicated slot isolation and HSM integration. Also they asked about data egress logging.
omar: Quick answers draft:
- Single-tenant/Dedicated: Yes, Dedicated provides isolated GPU pools and isolated tenancy for model serving. Logical separation plus dedicated VPC peering.
- Network isolation: Support VPC peering, private link, or customer VPN. We offer peering templates and can provide terraform snippets.
- HSM/KMS: Integrations supported via standard KMS connectors; HSM requires enterprise addendum and lead time.
- SLAs: 99.95% platform uptime on Dedicated, 99.9% for hosted API with tiers for enterprise. Include incident response SLOs.
claire: Add a note about audit logs retention—default 90 days, enterprise can request extended retention up to 3 years (paid add-on).
jules: Good. Also HelioHealth asked for token-level cost examples for their expected workload (300M tokens/month). Can someone produce a small cost table: hosted vs dedicated vs dedicated+burst?
nina: I'll assemble numbers. Any assumptions we should bake in? e.g., average tokens per call, seq length?
omar: Assume avg seq length 256 tokens, 2M calls/day ~300M tokens/month. For hosted: use standard token rate + egress. For dedicated: amortize reserved capacity + actual usage. For burst: add per-minute burst surcharge.
jules: Also include compatibility note: some quantized model variants are only available in Dedicated/private due to licensing.
claire: Compliance ask: HelioHealth requires SOC2 and ISO27001 evidence plus a third-party penetration test report within last 12 months.
jules: Let's commit to the follow-up timeline: Nina - cost table, Omar - written answers and legal phrasing for HSM addendum, Claire - compliance artifacts for attachment, and I'll assemble and send response tomorrow afternoon.
deploy-bot: created draft ticket COP-1423 for HelioHealth RFP response payload.
nina: Will share cost table CSV here when ready.
omar: Draft answer ready; will paste into workbook.
jules: Thanks team. We'll keep this as a tracked thread for any incoming clarifications from HelioHealth.
